steps.title: Add PBS to destination plate
steps.instruction: Using the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), dispense the user‑specified Destination plate PBS volume of PBS (NEST 12‑Well Reservoir, 15 mL, Row 2) into the destination plate: columns 1‑4 rows A‑H, then column 5 rows A‑E (use a fresh tip for the column 5 transfer).

substeps.instruction: Transfer PBS to columns 1‑4 rows A‑H.
Transfer PBS to column 5 rows A‑E with a new tip.

steps.title: Add 66% DMSO to destination plate
steps.instruction: Using the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), dispense the user‑specified Destination plate 66% DMSO volume of 66 % DMSO (NEST 12‑Well Reservoir, 15 mL, Row 1) into the destination plate: columns 6‑9 rows A‑H, then column 10 rows A‑E (use a fresh tip for the column 10 transfer).

substeps.instruction: Transfer 66 % DMSO to columns 6‑9 rows A‑H.
Transfer 66 % DMSO to column 10 rows A‑E with a new tip.

steps.title: Transfer source plate dilution volume
steps.instruction: With the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), aspirate the user‑specified Source plate volume for dilution from the source plate (columns 1‑4 rows A‑H and column 5 rows A‑E) and dispense it into the destination plate in the same layout (columns 1‑4 rows A‑H, column 5 rows A‑E). Replace tips between each column transfer.

steps.title: Mix initial destination columns
steps.instruction: Using the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), mix the contents of columns 1‑4 and column 5 rows A‑E of the destination plate by pipetting 20 µL up and down four times for each region. Replace tips between columns.

substeps.instruction: Mix column 5 rows A‑E (20 µL up/down ×4).

steps.title: Transfer dilution to second set
steps.instruction: With the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), aspirate the user‑specified Destination plate volume for dilution from the destination plate (columns 1‑4 rows A‑H and column 5 rows A‑E) and dispense it into columns 6‑9 rows A‑H and column 10 rows A‑E of the same plate. Replace tips between each column transfer.

steps.title: Mix second destination columns
steps.instruction: Using the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), mix columns 5‑9 and column 10 rows A‑E of the destination plate by pipetting 20 µL up and down four times for each region. Replace tips between columns.

substeps.instruction: Mix column 10 rows A‑E (20 µL up/down ×4).

steps.title: Aliquot library into culture plates
steps.instruction: If a Number of Destination Plates > 0 is selected, use the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) to aliquot the library plate (columns 1‑10 rows A‑H) into 2–3 empty SPL 96‑Well Cell Culture Plates, dispensing the user‑specified Library aliquot volume into each well.

substeps.instruction: Transfer library to first SPL plate.
Transfer library to second SPL plate (and third if selected).
